title: Treat Binance's XRP withdrawal phase as an unverified live event; extend Barrot workflow quarantine while preserving main
context: XRP Insights' latest accessible pinned observation is ledger 108037957 at 04:35 UTC and reports 1B XRP released, zero re-escrow by that ledger, and destination/later disposition unknown.
Binance Update #4 reports 95% aggregate recovery and includes XRP among ten assets claimed 100% backed.
The 06:00–09:00 UTC phase-one withdrawal window includes XRP and is progressive. At 06:05 UTC it is in progress, but the public network-status page exposes no asset-level row.
Reuters reports the same Binance company announcement; it is not independent reserve verification.
Main advanced to 694fc4241f543917fc6eb787c025bf1eb6726595 at 06:03:40 UTC via a telemetry report timestamp-only commit that retains Status: OPERATIONAL without deployment verification.
PR #1443 passed exact-head CI with 349 tests plus 8 subtests and a fail-closed gate; it remains open, draft and unmerged.
PR #1444 consolidates PR #1443 and additional writer/token/deployment protections. Its previous head failed four assertions; fixes are committed on the current head, whose CI rerun remains pending.

decisions.decision: Update the escrow event observation to ledger 108037957 at 04:35 UTC; retain tracker-reported execution and 1B net outside escrow at that ledger, with Destination and later disposition unknown.
decisions.reason: A newer pinned ledger supersedes the 02:31 observation without independently decoding raw transaction metadata.

decisions.decision: Classify Binance phase one as WINDOW_IN_PROGRESS; XRP_AVAILABILITY_UNCONFIRMED at 06:05 UTC.
decisions.reason: The official announcement is an event window; the live network-status page did not expose per-asset rows.

decisions.decision: Do not infer customer withdrawals or market selling from the schedule; require transaction-level external destination classification and venue/trade evidence.
decisions.reason: A withdrawal may be self-custody, exchange-to-exchange, institutional custody, or internal wallet reshuffling.

decisions.decision: Keep the 95% aggregate recovery and 100% XRP/RLUSD top-ten backing as company-reported claims pending full cryptographic PoR and liability reconciliation.
decisions.reason: No XRP-specific purchase quantity or independent asset/liability crosswalk is disclosed.

decisions.decision: Keep Ripple escrow and Binance reopening as separate graph events; no causal relationship is admitted.
decisions.reason: Temporal overlap alone is not causal evidence.

decisions.decision: Preserve PR #1443 and #1444 as draft/unmerged proposals; do not merge or dispatch workflows.
decisions.reason: Main still contains privileged workflows until an explicitly authorized change is merged; PR #1444 current-head CI is not yet verified.

decisions.decision: Treat main's 06:03:40 telemetry commit as a verified timestamp-only repository mutation with an unsupported OPERATIONAL status claim.
decisions.reason: The commit changes only AUTONOMOUS_DEPLOYMENT_REPORT.md timestamp; it does not verify deployment health.

decisions.decision: Do not admit market features or issue a directional XRP forecast from this update.
decisions.reason: Actual XRP withdrawal availability and flow, escrow disposition and independent reserve proof remain unknown.

ingestion_contract.source_independence: Reuters reports the same Binance announcement and is not independent reserve verification. Keep publisher and underlying information source distinct.

withdrawal_event_study.sale_inference_rule: A withdrawal or wallet transfer alone is not a sale; require venue deposit attribution and trade/flow evidence.

ingestion_contract.feature_admission: Require exact transaction/ledger timestamps, wallet-role evidence, source independence, provider coverage and missingness checks. Do not backfill unknown values as zero.
ingestion_contract.prediction_contract: Every forecast must state target, horizon, data cutoff, assumptions, probability/confidence, alternatives, baseline, model version, calibration and later outcome.
ingestion_contract.live_trading: Shadow/paper only until leakage-safe walk-forward skill, calibration, drift and execution controls are independently reviewed.

platform_coordination.rule: No live collaboration claim without successful least-privilege authentication and tested structured handoff.

unresolved: Actual XRP network withdrawal activation and first successful withdrawal timestamp.
Customer XRP withdrawal amounts, destinations and whether funds leave Binance-controlled custody.
XRP-specific replenishment purchases, venues, prices and funding sources.
Full cryptographic Proof of Reserves and asset/liability reconciliation.
Current attacker-wallet balance after the last October 31 observation.
Raw EscrowFinish Destination fields and follow-on disposition.
Main branch-protection details; the available endpoint returned 403.
Approval workflow zero-job anomaly, full repository CI and dependency/security scans.
Remaining scheduled and manual workflow mutation paths outside PRs #1443/#1444.
